summary: An official 2024 ecosystem study published in October 2025 reports at least 2,112 talents at game developers/publishers. Its public author abstract does not establish a complete national census or precise headcount date. Wider estimates of hundreds of thousands of affected jobs are economic impact, not core employment.

limitations: Survey coverage and observation timing not resolved from accessible public summary.
No stable national 2015–latest series; stated 64.23% growth not used to back-solve base count.
Application-plus-game employment totals are broader than video-game development.
No verified national citizenship or contractor composition.
